node.title: Re: XML round-trip with comments and prolog
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But my next goal was to round-trip the config file

My experience with [mod://XML::Rules] was that, sadly, it is not good at round-tripping XML files (Update: see also Jenda's comments [id://1203896|here]). IMHO, if that's what you want, I'd just go with [mod://XML::LibXML], in conjunction with its XPath support it's not too difficult to pull values out of the config file while maintaining the original XML file's structure. An alternative might be [mod://XML::Twig], though my experience with that is more limited.
